description: Header file defining the TimeDate class for handling broadcast time synchronization, including nested classes for notification and parsing, with methods for scanning, loading time data, and managing tuner state.

classes.name: TimeDate
classes.description: Main class managing broadcast time synchronization, tuner notifications, and parsing DVB sections.

classes.name: TimeDate::Sink
classes.description: Nested class implementing ITuner::INotification for handling tuner activation, deactivation, and state changes.

classes.name: TimeDate::Parser
classes.description: Nested class implementing ISection for parsing DVB TDT and TOT sections and updating time data.

methods.name: TimeDate()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TimeDate object and registering tuner notifications.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Enables or disables scanning of DVB sections.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles tuner deactivation events, removing tuner from internal list.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles tuner state changes, adding or removing scanners based on tuner state.

methods.name: Load (DVB::TOT&)
methods.description: Loads and updates time data from a DVB Time and Date Table (TOT).

methods.name: Load (DVB::TDT&)
methods.description: Loads and updates time data from a DVB Time and Date Table (TDT).
